title: LqDFx's WaxedWorkstations
description: Ability to use Honeycomb to wax workstations preventing Villagers from claiming them.
body:
LqDFx's WaxedWorkstations allows players to shift-rightclick with Homecomb on Workstation/Jobsite blocks
removing them from the POI system and keeping Villages from claiming them. This allows Workstation/Jobsite
to be used as decoration or to limit the number of Villagers with said Profession.

Shift-Rightclicking with an Axe will reverse the process and Villagers will once again be able to claim
the workstation.

Works with all Vanilla Workstation/Jobsite blocks. 

- Blast Furnace
- Smoker
- Cartography Table
- Brewing Stand
- Composter
- Barrel
- Fletching Table
- Cauldron
- Lectern
- Stonecutter
- Loom
- Smithing Table
- Grindstone
- Bell (Meeting)
- Bee Nest/Hive

May work with other modded Workstation/Jobsite blocks as long as they are registed in the POI.

* Blocked using this on Nether Portals, Lightning Rods, Lodestones, and Beds.

Tested on single player worlds, should work on Servers as long as the mod is loaded on the Server.
